name: u35-library-bounded
about: Current-architecture sensitivity, not a complete product request. The Oct31 session message at 06:36 MDT reported a Library with 12,180 rows, previously fetched before drawing, replaced by a first page of 50 (original transcript 9756a26f line 43949). Fixture size is measured historical state; note body size and 6 opens/day are assumptions. This bounded key-page operation maps to the product Records::list_page cursor contract and measures storage work only, not HTTP trips, JSON serialization, UI rendering, auth or current native admission. The unbounded control is intentionally the previous fetch-all behavior and must not be added to the bounded profile.
